SELECT DISTINCT A.*, EE.ENTRUST_TYPE, SCI.ACCT_NAME ACCOUNT_NAME FROM ( SELECT decode(TT.INSTRUCTION_ID, NULL, TTH.INSTRUCTION_ID) INSTRUCTION_ID, STD.APPLY_TRADE_ID ENTRUST_ID, STD.CJBH BROKER_TRADE_ID, STD.TRADE_MARKET MARKET, FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID STOCK_CODE, FP.FINPROD_ABBR STOCK_NAME, DECODE(TT.PS, NULL, TTH.PS) ENTRUST_BS, DECODE(TT.TRADED_VOLUME, NULL, TTH.TRADED_VOLUME) TRADED_VOLUME, DECODE(TT.TRADED_PRICE, NULL, TTH.TRADED_PRICE) TRADED_PRICE, DECODE(TT.TRADED_BALANCE, NULL, TTH.TRADED_BALANCE) TRADED_BALANCE, DECODE(TT.TRADING_DAY, NULL, TTH.TRADING_DAY) TRADING_DAY, TO_CHAR(DECODE(TT.CREATE_TIME, NULL, TTH.CREATE_TIME),'HH24:Mi:ss') TRADE_TIME, TT.CREATE_TIME CREATE_TIME, CASE WHEN STD.DELIVERY_RESULT IS NULL THEN '未交收' WHEN STD.DELIVERY_RESULT = '01' THEN '正常交收' WHEN STD.DELIVERY_RESULT = '02' THEN '部分交收' WHEN STD.DELIVERY_RESULT = '03' THEN '交收失败' WHEN STD.DELIVERY_RESULT = '04' THEN '未交收' WHEN STD.DELIVERY_RESULT = '05' THEN '交收通知' END DELIVERY_RESULT, CASE WHEN STD.DELIVERY_RESULT IS NULL THEN '0' WHEN STD.DELIVERY_RESULT = '04' THEN '0' ELSE STD.SHARE_AMT / TT.TRADED_VOLUME || '%' END DELIVERY_SCHEDULE, TTH.ACCOUNT_ID ACCT_ACCOUNT FROM SETTLE_TRANS_DATA STD LEFT JOIN T_TRADE TT ON (TT.BROKER_TRADE_ID = STD.CJBH AND TT.SEC_ACCT_ID = STD.SEC_ACCT_ID AND TT.TRADING_DAY = TO_CHAR(STD.TRADE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TT.TRADE_TYPE = '0') LEFT JOIN T_TRADEHISTORY TTH ON (TTH.BROKER_TRADE_ID = STD.CJBH AND TTH.SEC_ACCT_ID = STD.SEC_ACCT_ID AND TTH.TRADING_DAY = TO_CHAR(STD.TRADE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')) LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON STD.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID WHERE STD.DELIVERY_RESULT IN ('01', '02', '03', '05') AND ((STD.PS = 'T56' AND STD.TRADE_MARKET = '03' AND STD.BUSI_SCENE_CALSS NOT IN ('0902RB02', '0902RS03')) OR (STD.PS = 'T56' AND STD.TRADE_MARKET = '04') OR (STD.PS != 'T56')) UNION SELECT TT.INSTRUCTION_ID INSTRUCTION_ID, TT.BROKER_ENTRUST_ID ENTRUST_ID, TT.BROKER_TRADE_ID BROKER_TRADE_ID, CASE WHEN TT.MARKET = 'SH' THEN '上海证券交易所' WHEN TT.MARKET = 'SZ' THEN '深圳证券交易所' ELSE NULL END MARKET, TT.STOCK_CODE STOCK_CODE, TT.STOCK_NAME STOCK_NAME, TT.PS ENTRUST_BS, TT.TRADED_VOLUME TRADED_VOLUME, TT.TRADED_PRICE TRADED_PRICE, TT.TRADED_BALANCE TRADED_BALANCE, TT.TRADING_DAY TRADING_DAY, TO_CHAR(TT.CREATE_TIME,'HH24:Mi:ss') TRADE_TIME, TT.CREATE_TIME CREATE_TIME, CASE WHEN STD.DELIVERY_RESULT IS NULL THEN '未交收' WHEN STD.DELIVERY_RESULT = '01' THEN '正常交收' WHEN STD.DELIVERY_RESULT = '02' THEN '部分交收' WHEN STD.DELIVERY_RESULT = '03' THEN '交收失败' WHEN STD.DELIVERY_RESULT = '04' THEN '未交收' WHEN STD.DELIVERY_RESULT = '05' THEN '交收通知' END DELIVERY_RESULT, CASE WHEN STD.DELIVERY_RESULT IS NULL THEN '0' WHEN STD.DELIVERY_RESULT = '04' THEN '0' ELSE STD.SHARE_AMT / TT.TRADED_VOLUME || '%' END DELIVERY_SCHEDULE, TT.ACCOUNT_ID ACCT_ACCOUNT FROM T_TRADE TT LEFT JOIN SETTLE_TRANS_DATA STD ON TT.BROKER_TRADE_ID = STD.CJBH AND TT.SEC_ACCT_ID = STD.SEC_ACCT_ID AND STD.DELIVERY_RESULT IN ('01', '02', '03') AND TT.TRADING_DAY = TO_CHAR(STD.TRADE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND ((STD.PS = 'T56' AND STD.TRADE_MARKET = '03' AND STD.BUSI_SCENE_CALSS NOT IN ('0902RB02', '0902RS03')) OR (STD.PS = 'T56' AND STD.TRADE_MARKET = '04') OR (STD.PS != 'T56')) AND ( STD.SETTLE_SPEED = '0' OR STD.SETTLE_SPEED IS NULL ) WHERE TT.TRADE_TYPE = '0'
UNION SELECT tpda.ENTRUST_ID INSTRUCTION_ID, NULL ENTRUST_ID, tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID BROKER_TRADE_ID, CASE
WHEN tpd.TRADE_MARKET = '03' THEN '上海证券交易所' WHEN tpd.TRADE_MARKET = '04' THEN '深圳证券交易所' ELSE NULL END MARKET, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID STOCK_CODE, fp.FINPROD_ABBR STOCK_NAME, tpd.PS ENTRUST_BS, tpd.SHARE_AMT TRADED_VOLUME, tpd.CPRICE_AMT TRADED_PRICE, tpd.FPRICE_AMT TRADED_BALANCE, TO_CHAR( tpd.TRADE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) TRADING_DAY, TO_CHAR( tpd.CREATE_TIME, 'HH24:Mi:ss' ) TRADE_TIME, tpd.CREATE_TIME CREATE_TIME, '正常交收' DELIVERY_RESULT, '100' DELIVERY_SCHEDULE, ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID ACCT_ACCOUNT FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tpd LEFT JOIN TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD tpda ON tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpda.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON tpd.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai ON tpd.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID WHERE tpd.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND tpd.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F37' AND tpd.PS = 'T04' AND tpd.TRADE_DATE < to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') ) A LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO SCI ON A.ACCT_ACCOUNT = SCI.ACCT_NO LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST EE ON A.INSTRUCTION_ID = EE.ENTRUST_ID
WHERE A.INSTRUCTION_ID = #{instructionId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY A.CREATE_TIME DESC

select T.effectiveStatus, T.firstBidStatus, T.bidId, T.finprodId, T.finprodMarketId, T.finprodAbbr, T.tenderTarget, T.issueDateStart, T.issueDateEnd, SUM(T.etrBidPriceTotal) etrBidPriceTotal, T.tradeMarket, T.totalBiddingNum, T.bidprice, T.biddingMethod, T.payType, T.winPrice, T.price, T.tradeAmt, T.payableAmount, T.settFeeAmt, T.payDate, T.assignRegdate, T.listingDate, T.bidConfirmDate, T.counterId, T.counterName, T.remark, T.dealDate from ( SELECT CASE WHEN bo.IS_CANCEL = 'Y' THEN '03' ELSE '02' END AS effectiveStatus/*有效状态*/, CASE WHEN brt.IS_WIN = 'Y' THEN '04' WHEN brt.IS_WIN = 'N' THEN '03' WHEN brt.TOTAL_WIN_ID IS NULL THEN '02' END AS firstBidStatus/*中标状态*/, bo.BID_ID AS bidId/*投标编号*/, fp.FINPROD_ID finprodId, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, fp.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, fpi.TENDER_TARGET tenderTarget, CASE WHEN fpi.ISSUE_CLASS = '02' AND fpi.TENDER_TYPE IN ('01', '02') THEN fpi.ISSUE_DATE WHEN (fpi.ISSUE_CLASS = '02' AND (fpi.TENDER_TYPE IS NULL OR fpi.TENDER_TYPE IN ('03', '04'))) OR fpi.ISSUE_CLASS = '03' THEN fpi.TENDER_SDATE END AS issueDateStart/*投标日 开始*/, CASE WHEN fpi.ISSUE_CLASS = '02' AND fpi.TENDER_TYPE IN ('01', '02') THEN null WHEN (fpi.ISSUE_CLASS = '02' AND (fpi.TENDER_TYPE IS NULL OR fpi.TENDER_TYPE IN ('03', '04'))) OR fpi.ISSUE_CLASS = '03' THEN fpi.TENDER_EDATE END AS issueDateEnd/*投标日 结束*/, ee.ENTRUST_NUM *100 AS etrBidPriceTotal/*指令投标券面总额*/, ee.TRADE_MARKET AS tradeMarket/*交易市场*/, bo.WIN_PRIN_AMT AS totalBiddingNum/*券面总额*/, bobp.BID_PRICE AS bidprice/*投标标位, 多个逗号分隔展示*/, bo.BID_MODLE AS biddingMethod/*投标方式*/, bo.PAY_TYPE AS payType/*缴款方式*/, case when fpi.TENDER_TARGET = '01' then to_char(bo.WIN_PRICE * 100, 'FM9999999999999990.9990') || '%' when fpi.TENDER_TARGET = '02' then to_char(bo.WIN_PRICE, 'FM9999999999999990.9990') || '元' when fpi.TENDER_TARGET = '03' then to_char(bo.WIN_PRICE * 10000, 'FM9999999999999990.90') || 'BP' end winPrice/*中标标位*/, bo.UNIT_CPRICE price/*净价*/, bo.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt/*交易金额*/, bo.PAYABLE_AMOUNT payableAmount/*缴款金额*/, bo.SETT_FEE_AMT settFeeAmt/*结算服务费*/, bo.PAY_DATE payDate/*缴款日*/, bo.ASSIGN_REGDATE assignRegdate/*债权债务登记日*/, bo.ONMARKET_DATE listingDate/*上市日*/, bo.BID_DATE AS bidConfirmDate/*投标确认日*/, bo.COUNTER_ID AS counterId/*交易对手*/, mcp.COUNTER_NAME AS counterName, bo.REMARK AS remark/*备注*/, bo.BID_DATE dealDate/*成交日期*/ FROM BID_ORDER bo LEFT JOIN (select listagg(case when t3.TENDER_TARGET = '01' then to_char(t0.BID_PRICE * 100, 'FM9999999999999990.9990') || '%' when t3.TENDER_TARGET = '02' then to_char(t0.BID_PRICE, 'FM9999999999999990.9990') || '元' when t3.TENDER_TARGET = '03' then to_char(t0.BID_PRICE * 10000, 'FM9999999999999990.90') || 'BP' end, ',') within group (order by t0.ENTRUST_ID) AS BID_PRICE, t0.BID_ID from BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE t0 LEFT JOIN BID_ORDER t1 on t1.BID_ID = t0.BID_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT t2 ON t2.FINPROD_ID = t1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ISSUE t3 ON t3.FINPROD_ID = t2.FINPROD_ID group by t0.BID_ID) bobp ON bobp.BID_ID = bo.BID_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = bo.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN (select distinct ENTRUST_ID, BID_ID from BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE) bobp1 ON bobp1.BID_ID = bo.BID_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ISSUE fpi ON fpi.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN BID_RESULT_TOTAL brt ON brt.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID AND brt.BID_ID = bo.BID_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST ee ON ee.ENTRUST_ID = bobp1.ENTRUST_ID left join MST_COUNTER_PARTY mcp ON mcp.COUNTER_ID = bo.COUNTER_ID
bo.TRADE_STATUS = '01'
AND ee.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId} /*指令代码查询*/
union all SELECT '01' AS effectiveStatus/*有效状态*/, CASE WHEN brt.IS_WIN = 'Y' THEN '04' WHEN brt.IS_WIN = 'N' THEN '03' WHEN brt.TOTAL_WIN_ID IS NULL THEN '02' END AS firstBidStatus/*中标状态*/, bo.BID_ID AS bidId/*投标编号*/, fp.FINPROD_ID finprodId, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, fp.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, fpi.TENDER_TARGET tenderTarget, CASE WHEN fpi.ISSUE_CLASS = '02' AND fpi.TENDER_TYPE IN ('01', '02') THEN fpi.ISSUE_DATE WHEN (fpi.ISSUE_CLASS = '02' AND (fpi.TENDER_TYPE IS NULL OR fpi.TENDER_TYPE IN ('03', '04'))) OR fpi.ISSUE_CLASS = '03' THEN fpi.TENDER_SDATE END AS issueDateStart/*投标日 开始*/, CASE WHEN fpi.ISSUE_CLASS = '02' AND fpi.TENDER_TYPE IN ('01', '02') THEN null WHEN (fpi.ISSUE_CLASS = '02' AND (fpi.TENDER_TYPE IS NULL OR fpi.TENDER_TYPE IN ('03', '04'))) OR fpi.ISSUE_CLASS = '03' THEN fpi.TENDER_EDATE END AS issueDateEnd/*投标日 结束*/, ee.ENTRUST_NUM*100 AS etrBidPriceTotal/*指令投标券面总额*/, ee.TRADE_MARKET AS tradeMarket/*交易市场*/, bo.WIN_PRIN_AMT AS totalBiddingNum/*券面总额*/, bobp.BID_PRICE AS bidprice/*投标标位, 多个逗号分隔展示*/, bo.BID_MODLE AS biddingMethod/*投标方式*/, bo.PAY_TYPE AS payType/*缴款方式*/, case when fpi.TENDER_TARGET = '01' then to_char(bo.WIN_PRICE * 100, 'FM9999999999999990.9990') || '%' when fpi.TENDER_TARGET = '02' then to_char(bo.WIN_PRICE, 'FM9999999999999990.9990') || '元' when fpi.TENDER_TARGET = '03' then to_char(bo.WIN_PRICE * 10000, 'FM9999999999999990.90') || 'BP' end winPrice/*中标标位*/, bo.UNIT_CPRICE price/*净价*/, bo.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt/*交易金额*/, bo.PAYABLE_AMOUNT payableAmount/*缴款金额*/, bo.SETT_FEE_AMT settFeeAmt/*结算服务费*/, bo.PAY_DATE payDate/*缴款日*/, bo.ASSIGN_REGDATE assignRegdate/*债权债务登记日*/, bo.ONMARKET_DATE listingDate/*上市日*/, bo.BID_DATE AS bidConfirmDate/*投标确认日*/, bo.COUNTER_ID AS counterId/*交易对手*/, mcp.COUNTER_NAME AS counterName, bo.REMARK AS remark/*备注*/, bo.BID_DATE dealDate/*成交日期*/ FROM WFL_BID_ORDER bo LEFT JOIN (select listagg(case when t3.TENDER_TARGET = '01' then to_char(t0.BID_PRICE * 100, 'FM9999999999999990.9990') || '%' when t3.TENDER_TARGET = '02' then to_char(t0.BID_PRICE, 'FM9999999999999990.9990') || '元' when t3.TENDER_TARGET = '03' then to_char(t0.BID_PRICE * 10000, 'FM9999999999999990.90') || 'BP' end, ',') within group (order by t0.ENTRUST_ID) AS BID_PRICE, t0.BID_ID from WFL_BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE t0 LEFT JOIN WFL_BID_ORDER t1 on t1.BID_ID = t0.BID_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT t2 ON t2.FINPROD_ID = t1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ISSUE t3 ON t3.FINPROD_ID = t2.FINPROD_ID group by t0.BID_ID) bobp ON bobp.BID_ID = bo.BID_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = bo.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN (select distinct ENTRUST_ID, BID_ID from WFL_BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE) bobp1 ON bobp1.BID_ID = bo.BID_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ISSUE fpi ON fpi.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN BID_RESULT_TOTAL brt ON brt.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID AND brt.BID_ID = bo.BID_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST ee ON ee.ENTRUST_ID = bobp1.ENTRUST_ID left join MST_COUNTER_PARTY mcp ON mcp.COUNTER_ID = bo.COUNTER_ID
AND ee.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId} /*指令代码查询*/
) T group by T.effectiveStatus, T.firstBidStatus, T.bidId, T.finprodId, T.finprodMarketId, T.finprodAbbr, T.tenderTarget, T.issueDateStart, T.issueDateEnd, T.etrBidPriceTotal, T.tradeMarket, T.totalBiddingNum, T.bidprice, T.biddingMethod, T.payType, T.winPrice, T.price, T.tradeAmt, T.payableAmount, T.settFeeAmt, T.payDate, T.assignRegdate, T.listingDate, T.bidConfirmDate, T.counterId, T.counterName, T.remark, T.dealDate

SELECT distinct decode(tpd.is_cancel,'Y',#{TRADE_FLOW_STATUS03},#{TRADE_FLOW_STATUS02}) effectFlag,
FROM trd_product_deal tpd LEFT JOIN trd_product_deal_add tpda ON tpd.trade_id = tpda.trade_id left join WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_OTH wtpdo on wtpdo.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID left join TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tpdt on tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID=tpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON tpda.portfolio_id = pp.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON tpd.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl_registorg on fp.REGIST_ORG=sdl_registorg.ITEM_CODE and sdl_registorg.DICT_CODE='REGIST_ORG' LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY mcp ON tpd.counter_id = mcp.counter_id LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai ON tpd.sec_manage_acct_id = ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON tpd.FINPROD_ID = fpt.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT FTP on tpd.FINPROD_ID = FTP.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE on tpd.FINPROD_ID = FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp2 ON fp2.FINPROD_ID = tpd.CHL_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp3 ON fp3.FINPROD_ID = FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN BID_RESULT_TOTAL BRT ON BRT.TOTAL_WIN_ID = tpdt.B_TRADE_ID AND BRT.STATUS ='01' LEFT JOIN BID_ORDER BO ON BO.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND BO.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND BO.BID_ID = BRT.BID_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST ee ON ee.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId} WHERE tpd.TRADE_ID = (SELECT TRADE_ID FROM trd_product_deal_add WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}) OR tpd.B_TRADE_ID = (SELECT TRADE_ID FROM trd_product_deal_add WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}) union all SELECT #{TRADE_FLOW_STATUS01} effectFlag,
FROM wfl_trd_product_deal tpd LEFT JOIN wfl_trd_product_deal_add tpda ON tpd.trade_id = tpda.trade_id left join WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_OTH wtpdo on wtpdo.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID left join WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tpdt on tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID=tpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON tpda.portfolio_id = pp.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON tpd.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl_registorg on fp.REGIST_ORG=sdl_registorg.ITEM_CODE and sdl_registorg.DICT_CODE='REGIST_ORG' LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY mcp ON tpd.counter_id = mcp.counter_id LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai ON tpd.sec_manage_acct_id = ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON tpd.FINPROD_ID = fpt.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT FTP on tpd.FINPROD_ID = FTP.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE on tpd.FINPROD_ID = FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp2 ON fp2.FINPROD_ID = tpd.CHL_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp3 ON fp3.FINPROD_ID = FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN BID_RESULT_TOTAL BRT ON BRT.TOTAL_WIN_ID = tpdt.B_TRADE_ID AND BRT.STATUS ='01' LEFT JOIN BID_ORDER BO ON BO.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND BO.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND BO.BID_ID = BRT.BID_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST ee ON ee.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId} WHERE tpd.TRADE_ID = (SELECT TRADE_ID FROM wfl_trd_product_deal_add WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}) OR tpd.B_TRADE_ID = (SELECT TRADE_ID FROM wfl_trd_product_deal_add WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId})

mapper.select: SELECT T9.ENTRUST_ID, LISTAGG(to_char(T9.BID_PRICE * 100,'fm99990.0000') || '%', ',') WITHIN GROUP (order by (T9.BID_PRICE * 100)) etrPrice, CASE WHEN T10.BID_ID IS NULL THEN '01' WHEN T10.TRADE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN '05' WHEN T10.IS_WIN IS NOT NULL THEN DECODE(T10.IS_WIN,'Y','04','N','03',T10.IS_WIN) ELSE '02' END isWin FROM ETR_ENTRUST_BID_PRICE T9 LEFT JOIN BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE T10 ON T10.ENTRUST_ID = T9.ENTRUST_ID AND T10.BID_PRICE = T9.BID_PRICE where T9.ENTRUST_ID=#{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY T9.ENTRUST_ID, T10.BID_ID, T10.IS_WIN,T10.TRADE_ID

SELECT ee.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, trunc(nvl(efs.ENT_FINISH_AMT, 0), 2) execFinishAmt, trunc((nvl(ee.ENTRUST_NUM*100,0) - nvl(efs.ENT_FINISH_AMT, 0)),2) execRemainderAmt, trunc(nvl(efs.ENT_FINISH_AMT, 0) / case when ee.ENTRUST_NUM is null or ee.ENTRUST_NUM = 0 then 1 else ee.ENTRUST_NUM*100 end, 4) * 100 exeProgress, trunc(nvl(tpd.SHARE_AMT * 100, 0),2) transFinishAmt, trunc((nvl(ee.ENTRUST_NUM*100,0) - nvl(tpd.SHARE_AMT * 100, 0)),2) transRemainderAmt, trunc(nvl(tpd.SHARE_AMT * 100, 0) / case when ee.ENTRUST_NUM is null or ee.ENTRUST_NUM = 0 then 1 else ee.ENTRUST_NUM*100 end, 4) * 100 dealProgress FROM ETR_ENTRUST ee left join (select sum(ENT_FINISH_AMT) ENT_FINISH_AMT, sum(FINISH_AMT) FINISH_AMT, ENTRUST_ID from ETR_FINISH_STATUS group by ENTRUST_ID) efs on ee.ENTRUST_ID = efs.ENTRUST_ID left join (select sum(t1.SHARE_AMT) SHARE_AMT, t2.ENTRUST_ID from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t1 left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD t2 on t1.TRADE_ID = t2.TRADE_ID where t1.IS_CANCEL = 'N' and t1.TRADE_STATUS != '03' group by t2.ENTRUST_ID) tpd on tpd.ENTRUST_ID = ee.ENTRUST_ID where ee.ENTRUST_ID=#{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
